Ava (CEO): Quick follow-up from the all-hands — thanks everyone. A few teams asked about behavior during product launches: how do rate limits, short-term bursts, and free credits interact? Do we have a clear, actionable playbook teams can use? :wave:

Samir (VP Product): TL;DR — yes, there's an established flow. We expose a per-account burst buffer for short spikes, but it's not infinite. Normal behavior: soft allowance for a short window, then signal clients with 429s and a Retry-After header. For launch support we can temporarily expand the buffer after a request/approval. Docs: https://redwood.example.com/docs/billing#burst

Maya (PM): Can we add the playbook to the console as a "Launch Support" checklist? Customers and internal teams keep asking the same questions. :thinking:

Samir (VP Product): Good call. Action: add checklist + a one-click support request for temporary burst increases. We'll also include recommended client retry/backoff patterns (exponential backoff with jitter). ETA: next sprint.

Jamie (Finance): Note on credits: promotional credits are strictly time-limited and do not auto-rollover. Committed/reserved capacity is a separate product — those customers get different quotas and SLA. If you want a short-term invoice credit instead of a platform-level burst, work with Sales/Finance.

Riley (Support): If a customer pings support with a launch spike, include: expected window, peak RPS, app URL, account ID. We have a hotline for mission-critical launches. Use /support/launch-request in the console. :white_check_mark:

Maya (PM): Is there an API for programmatic quota increases during CI/CD driven launches? We run scheduled migrations that can temporarily exceed normal quotas.

DevOpsBot: Default write QPS: 60 req/s per customer token, token bucket burst up to 20% for 30s. Admin API: POST /admin/accounts/{id}/temp_quota with body {"delta_rps": <int>, "duration_s": <int>, "reason": "<string>"}

Samir (VP Product): For the API we'll require authorization from an account lead + an automated risk check. We can't permit arbitrary automated increases without guardrails. We'll publish the API in the next docs update; meanwhile use the console form.

Maya (PM): Can we make an internal runbook for on-call to follow when launch requests come in? Steps, checks, TL;DR yes/no decision. I'll draft one and post to #eng-oncall.

Ava (CEO): Thanks — prioritize the customer-facing checklist and console support flow. Make sure Sales/CS know the gating criteria so they can plan outreach. :rocket:

Samir (VP Product): Filed: ENG-REQ-4123 (console checklist + support button) and DOCS-211 (billing FAQ). I'll ping when PRs are up.

Riley (Support): I'll add a canned response template for launch requests.

DevOpsBot: Deploy note: rate-limit config pushed to prod at 2026-03-23T15:10Z. If you see anomalies, ping #eng-sre and include the account ID.

Maya (PM): Thanks all — I'll follow up in #product with the draft runbook. Closing this thread unless someone needs more context. :slightly_smiling_face:
